sentences.text: The documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable toward interest and principal, and they also define EMIs as monthly periodic instalments.
The record does not provide an evidence item for a 9.75% annual rate or for a 78-month tenor for this loan, so the EMI for those inputs cannot be confirmed from the evidence alone.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force loan documents and UCB directions for an EMI formula or an evidence item matching 9.75% per annum and 78 months; the only EMI figures found are for different loan terms and amounts.
